invariants.rationale: If the method does not return null, it returns an Actor, by the contract of its return type.
If the Window is not visible, hit returns null immediately.
If the result is not null, then the window must be visible, as all non-visible cases return null.
The method only returns 'this' if hit == null, isModal is true, and (!touchable || getTouchable() == Touchable.enabled), so if touchable is false and those conditions match, result can be 'this'.
The method always returns either null, this, or another Actor.
